# Preregistered controls
Before outcomes: P1 polynomial analogue mvar_5a829e (dimension2, x0**3+x0*x1+x1-2), default-init MLP depth3 width256 nonresidual leaky_relu slope .01 LN[true,false,true], MSE, AdamW wd1e-5 betas[.9,.999]. Cross lr3e-5/1e-3 and T256/2048, batch16, samples4096/32768. Predict high rate wins at T256 but low rate wins T2048 (test-MSE endpoint); a high-rate long-budget win falsifies transfer of q_38909f's ordinal reversal to this analogue. P2 piecewise analogue stabcls_06550f, dimension16, default-init depth4 width256 GELU nonresidual LN[true,false,true,false], CE, Adagrad wd1e-3. Cross lr1e-4/3e-3 and T128/512 batch64 (8/32 exposure epochs, samples8192/32768). Predict high rate wins T128 and low wins T512; long-budget high win falsifies rate-only account of q_a57013. All changes start fresh runs; no continuation or optimizer-state intervention is requested. Ten seeds per cell; ratios of mean held-out losses and absolute high-minus-low margins; aggregate standard deviations not paired-seed significance. No mechanisms inferred from endpoint losses alone. Next dataset transfer conditional on completing these tests. Existing experiments audited: mvar_000e80 Adam width32 SiLU budget reversal and stabcls_021b60 depth1 ReLU Adam controls are not repeated.

Protocol correction before plain-MSE outcomes: P1 inherited mse_l2 lambda.001, not preregistered plain mse. Retain and label that result, do not use it as plain-MSE evidence. New plain mse lambda0 controls on mvar_5a829e repeat rates/T with same config to test loss sensitivity. Predict same short-high/long-low crossover, but report contrary results. Dataset transfer mvar_93e6af dimension2 polynomial at T2048 using identical plain-MSE recipe: predict low-rate wins; high-rate win refutes general polynomial ceiling. Tabular transfer stabcls_2173ed dimension16 smooth_additive at T512 batch64, identical GELU depth4 width256 LN and Adagrad wd.001: predict high rate .003 beats .0001 as in piecewise (no dataset reversal). These are fresh-run endpoint comparisons, no causal mechanism assertion.
